results.title: Aims & Scope | International Journal of Computer and Systems Engineering | Fairfield University
results.content: ## Aims & Scope. *The International Journal of Computer and Systems Engineering* publishes papers that report advances across the rapidly evolving fields of computer engineering, computer-based systems, and systems engineering. Reflecting the ubiquity of computer systems—from embedded devices to large-scale mission-critical infrastructures—the journal welcomes submissions covering their design, production, operation, and testing, as well as the engineering of hardware, software, networking, and cyber-physical integration. In addition to these core areas, the journal actively encourages work on **autonomous and robotic platforms, AI/ML for perception and control, and sensor and information fusion**, along with studies that sit at the interface of these domains and other branches of engineering. Beyond original research articles, *The International Journal of Computer and Systems Engineering* also publishes focused reviews that examine the state of the art, identify emerging trends, and outline future directions in fast-moving fields. *International Journal of Computer and Systems Engineering (IJCASE)* is a refereed online journal and forum for high-quality theoretical or empirical research articles, case studies, tutorials, and editorials in computer science and engineering. Topics of interest include, but are not limited to:. * AI/ML for perception and control. * Adaptive, autonomic and context-aware computing. * Advanced Computing Architectures and New Programming Models. * Artificial Intelligence & Pattern/Image Recognition. * Computer Architecture and Embedded Systems. * Cryptography and Foundations of Computer Security. * Data Mining, Information Retrieval, and Visualization. * Energy-efficient and green pervasive computing. * Fuzzy logic, neural networks, and hybrid computational methods. * Grid and High-performance Computing. * Internet of Things and Ubiquitous Networks. * Middleware, Service-oriented, and Autonomic Computing. * Network Security, Privacy, and Trust. * Real-time Systems and Control. * Smart Devices and Intelligent Environments. * Any emerging topic relevant to the latest trends in computer science, information technology, and systems engineering. * Receive Email Notices or RSS.
